reproducibility_gaps: README says to install packages using requirements.txt, but that file combines invalid pip-style names and a conda-list table rather than an installable requirements or environment specification.
The training validation loop enumerates vdata but evaluates tdata from the preceding training loop, so validation losses do not represent the configured validation split.
Only the hybrid model/checkpoint pair is wired into test.py/test.ipynb; the two ablations and two comparators require source-level model/checkpoint changes.
The training default is one epoch while bundled checkpoints are labeled epoch 50; the final training command and random seeds are not supplied.
No pinned numerical reference metrics or tolerances are documented.
notes: R3 is assigned to the pretrained hybrid test workflow because source, exact checkpoint, dataset retrieval path, preprocessing, entrypoint, and metrics are substantially available; retraining and non-hybrid configurations are not promoted to the same completeness.
No dataset/checkpoint payload was opened and no workload was executed; R5 remains prohibited.
